products.title: Vibora White Shoulder Bag - Vibora
products.description:
WHITE VIBORA CROSSBODY BAG - High-end Vibora crossbody bag. For players who do not want a large padel bag or backpack, this is an excellent option to transport padel equipment comfortably and safely. The VIBORA WHITE CROSSBODY BAG is a perfect option for those looking for a comfortable, practical accessory with personality on and off the court. As it is a shoulder bag, it has an adjustable handle to be able to carry it comfortably. This product is an elegant replacement for a backpack or padel bag that normally takes up more space. It is the perfect complement for those of us who want better organization.

It has a large main compartment, designed to carry sports clothing, accessories or personal belongings in an orderly and accessible way. Its capacity is optimized to transport essentials without being uncomfortable or bulky.

products.description: We bring the PACK OF 3 DUNLOP FORT PADEL BOTTLES, this ball guarantees good durability since it is high-end. It is a ball that favors play in all seasons of the year.  With this ball you will be able to achieve a more aggressive and therefore effective game.

products.title: Enebe Future Socks - Padel Socks
products.description:
ENEBE FUTURE SOCKS - Innovative design, high comfort and good sensations for optimal movements. ENEBE FUTURE SOCKS are available in 4 colors, white gray, black gray, black gray and red gray. With a striking design and a very careful composition, Enebe has created socks that leave no one indifferent. 

They stand out for their comfort, good fit and excellent breathability, something that is very important when moving around the padel court in all movements.

products.title: Royal Paddle Anniversary 36 Pink 2026 - Royal Paddle
products.description:
ROYAL PADEL ANNIVERSARY 36 PINK 2026 - One of the best padel rackets on the market to avoid injuries and elbow pain. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The ROYAL PADEL ANNIVERSARY 36 PINK 2026, one of the most special Royal Padel padel rackets in the collection. With an anti-vibration system in its core, it offers a total reduction of vibrations when hitting. Ideal for players who suffer discomfort when playing.

PLAYER TYPE

Recommended for both female and high-level players. It is a racket that offers balance. On the track, we will have both control and power. It is a racket with which the ball is easily launched.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

Royal Padel is quality. Each racket, made by hand, offers the best performance. The ROYAL PADEL ANIVERSARIO 36 PINK 2026 is an oversized round format racket, a round shape but with an intermediate balance, ideal for increasing the balance a little towards the middle of the racket, to achieve better balance.

Made with top-level 3K carbon fiber, with a perfect interlacing that offers elasticity and great durability.

Its core is made of polyethylene, the best rubber to reduce vibrations and achieve a powerful sound with each blow.

products.title: Softee Geometry Protector - Protectors
products.description:
SOFTEE GEOMETRY PROTECTOR - New model of Softee protector, of the highest quality, with a rough touch and a modern design. Available in different colors, such as red, blue, silver or gold, choose the one you like before they are sold out.

products.title: 750ml Softee Gym Blue Bottle - Accessories
products.description:
750ML SOFTEE GYM BLUE BOTTLE - A practical and comfortable bottle to take to the gym or to your padel training sessions. The 750ML SOFTEE GYM BLUE BOTTLE is a very practical and functional accessory for our matches, padel training or to take to the gym comfortably.

It has a non-slip area, which improves grip even when hands are wet or sweaty, preventing the bottle from slipping during use. In addition, it incorporates an ergonomic lid with a practical spout, which makes it easy to drink comfortably without having to unscrew it.

With a capacity of 750 ml, it offers the perfect size to maintain good hydration during physical activity.
